subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v3 02/11] mountd: handle unmountable paths and junctions in the netlink downcall

2026-09-14.patch_summary: This patch improves the handling of unmountable paths and junctions in the netlink downcall by nfsd_export(). It introduces a new function to check for junctions before denying exports, and splits the lookup_nonexport() function so that both downcalls can share the junction lookup. The patch also adds support for deferred requests, which are retried from cache_process() every RETRY_SEC seconds. This allows the kernel to keep the upcall pending in the meantime, improving performance and reliability.
